title: Bugs/632378 make quality inspection gen rule warning actionable
summary: Fixes bug 632378 by making the Quality Management inspection generation rule warning actionable. The changes touch the generation rule table, the rules page, the management codeunit, the Create Inspection report and the receiving and warehouse setup guide pages.
key_points: Makes the warning about quality inspection generation rules actionable
Changes span the generation rule table, the rules page, the management codeunit and the Create Inspection report
Small adjustments to the receiving and warehouse generation rule setup guides
Tests and test library helpers added for generation rules
